Windows dedicated-server mod for persistent terrain edits inside and outside Flame Altar claims, with configurable ore and clay respawns.

**Install Enshwick alpha 11 separately. The loader is not included.**

Download the Windows ZIP below and copy its `mods` folder into your server folder. The configuration file is created on first start; the default ore/clay respawn delay is 30 minutes.

[Installation and settings](https://github.com/kulcris/enshrouded-terrain-persistence#install)

This update simplifies the installation guide and removes redundant files from the download. Source code remains available in the repository.
